{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A black silk chiffon blouse with a subtle sheen, relaxed cut, cropped length at the waist, deep obsidian (#050505), smooth fluid fabric.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers in matte charcoal wool crepe, straight cut from hip to ankle, dark grey (#36454F), heavy drape material.
A structured black leather moto jacket with silver zippers and asymmetric closure, boxy but fitted silhouette, mid-thigh length, jet black (#000000), sturdy synthetic leather.
Chunky black platform sneakers with a rubber sole, wide toe box, solid matte black (#1C1C1C), durable textile and rubber upper.

This outfit strikes the perfect balance between club-ready edge and concert practicality while adhering to your wish for Friday night social wear. The wide-leg trousers allow you to walk around freely during the show without restriction, while the leather moto jacket adds a necessary layer of warmth against the cool November air inside the venue. The matte charcoal tones keep the look grounded and versatile, ensuring you stay stylish whether sitting in the audience or mingling between sets. By choosing dark, monochromatic pieces with high-quality textures, the ensemble feels intentionally curated rather than just dressed up, avoiding any overly rigid "business" vibes that might clash with the rock atmosphere."}
